rules.description: SYN attempt to the TLS service; correlate the complete transport handshake separately.
Visible Certificate (TLS 1.2) or encrypted TLS record (TLS 1.3). Certificate validation is established by the client tests, not this smoke check.
Encrypted TLS record is present. TLS 1.3 also encrypts handshake messages, so application delivery requires the separate request/response test.

manual_checks: Provide a passing test in which the client validates the server certificate and a test rejecting an untrusted certificate.
Provide a passing application request/response assertion with correlated client/server logs. A handshake-only capture is insufficient for project acceptance.
Optional: decrypt this local test with --tls-keylog PATH. Do not commit session secrets or downgrade TLS to make Certificate visible.
R1 R2 R3 R4: Record TLS version and a passing validation test, plus rejection of an untrusted certificate. TLS 1.3 encrypts Certificate after ServerHello.
R5: Assert the application result and correlate client/server logs. A handshake-only encrypted record cannot establish application delivery; optional key logging is local-test evidence.
